description.text: Main Courses Career Preparation and Planning, Outline of Modern and Contemporary China History, Fundamentals of Information Technology, College English, Physical Culture, College Chinese, Advanced Mathematics, Tourism Management, etc. Cultivation Goal The goal of tourism management major is to cultivate the students to meet the needs of market economy development. The students will master the basic theories and basic knowledge of tourism management, economics and management, have professional abilities in tourist market research, tourist market planning, tourist market development, tourist market operation and management, tourism resources planning and development, tourism route design, etc. And the students will be trained as senior management professionals who have competency in tourist market planning, tourist market research, tourist market development, tourist market operation and management, tourism resources planning and development, tourism route design in tourism administration departments of governments, tourism enterprises and hotels.

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Soochow University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3-6 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required
